svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Signature GT — White Navigation
svg.desc: Signature GT preserves its white Avenir Next and red Snell Roundhand hero, untinted Ferrari 458 Italia photo, editorial collection section and red legal footer. Only the transparent header changes: the original crest sits beside a white wordmark directly on blue sky, and white icon-and-text navigation pairs a compass, collection cards, an open journal, an information mark and the existing garage icon with their labels.

g.text: FOR THE CARS THAT STAY WITH YOU

text.tspan: Make a place for your next dream.

g.text: RED EXTERIOR / TAN INTERIOR / SILVER WHEELS

text.tspan: Turn a passing obsession into a personal collection.
Keep the cars you love close.
See which one speaks to you.

g.text: A home for the cars you dream about.
